committee: * Presentation for Legislative Certificate No. 392-38 (COR) -Senator Sabrina Salas Matanane
title: Håfa Adai, Please join me in presenting Legislative Certificate No. 392-38 (COR) to the Association of the United States Army (AUSA) Guam Chapter, in recognition of its outstanding dedication to supporting service members, veterans, and their families, and for its leadership in coordinating the successful 251st Army Birthday Ball, commemorating 251 years of service, sacrifice, and commitment by the United States Army. The presentation is scheduled for Friday, June 12, 2026, at 8:20 p.m. during the 251st Army Birthday Ball at the Hyatt Regency Guam. For more information about the presentation,…
